name: TOTEME
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $450 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's ready-to-wear, outerwear, knits, denim, bags, shoes and jewelry at designer prices (cashmere knits around $750), sold through own stores, website and department stores.
origin: Founded in 2014 by Elin Kling; Karl Lindman.

ownership.owner: TOTEME AB — founders hold the majority; Altor Fund V minority investor (2021)

quote.q: With an appreciation for how pieces are worn in practice, we create emblematic designs with an emphasis on materiality and shape.

opview: “With an appreciation for how pieces are worn in practice, we create emblematic designs with an emphasis on materiality and shape.” — TOTEME (house), Our Story, toteme.com

facts_read.source: brand site (Our Story, Runway pages, Garderob); Vinge mandate 2021-05-21; B Lab profile; GOTS database; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue page; TRR designer index

Jeans.hp: Classic slim denim full length faded blue

price_read.sublines: Garderob (TOTEME curation sold under the brand)

doors.note: 6 US rows: 5 open own doors + LA Palisades "Temporarily closed" (returned status closed, not counted). Note A.L.C. lists its Palisades Village store open (batch 2).

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 83 of 384 women's RTW styles, proportional by product type; census from /en-us/collections/ready-to-wear/products.json (699 products), swim

craft_evidence.owned: no — design atelier in Stockholm; making is by suppliers 'in Europe and China' (/pages/sustainability)
craft_evidence.makers: yes — the manufacturer is named on 71 of 83 product pages (e.g. Texmade-Têxteis Lda and Confetil, Portugal; Simiz Fashion SRL, Romania; Mergü Tekstil and Orjin Deri, Turkey; Zhejiang Langyi Clothing,
craft_evidence.mills: no mill names; fabric origin stated per product ('Material woven in Italy; dyed in Italy', 'knit in Portugal', 'woven in Japan' for denim); certifications RWS/GOTS/OCS/GRS with Control Union licence n
craft_evidence.madein: 59 of 83 product pages state a country (Portugal 21, China 15, Turkey 12, Romania 6, Lithuania 2, Hong Kong 2, Japan 1,
craft_evidence.heritage: founded 2014 in Stockholm by Elin Kling and Karl Lindman (/pages/our-story)
craft_evidence.process: partial — fabric weave/knit and dye country per product; Fair Wear member with audited factories; LWG-certified tanneries for 98% of leather; no description of making itself
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every product page names the garment maker, the country of make and where the cloth was woven/knit and dyed — the most verifiable making disclosure in thread 2 so far, backed by a public Open Supply Hub list and Fair Wear audits. But the makers are third-party suppliers, nothing is owned, and the house is 12 years old: 3 (a 4 would need owned or exclusive making).
